hb260928enr-deps.note: Filled from Confluence https://expoplatform.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/~5fa296e7c2e5390077b973be/pages/2138374153/Group+Registration+concept+and+proposal (Two commercial decisions; Things that will bite; Open questions; Module by module); EP-27117 comment 2024-03-19 by Evgen Polivach
hb260928enr-deps.to: Needs an engineering estimate on one data model change: a ticket (slot) that exists without an attendee profile. Blocked by two commercial decisions (how volume bands combine with early bird and discount codes; what happens when a refund drops an order below a band) and a decision on whether slots are claimable before an invoice is paid. Touches 16 modules (basket quantity, ticketing per-order cap, discounts, emails, Open API, kiosks must refuse unassigned slots). Registration and payment were split across two teams in EP-27117.
